operation.summary: Publish build tool events belonging to the same stream to a backend job using bidirectional streaming.
Publish a build event stating the new state of a build (typically from the build queue).
operation.description: Publish a build event stating the new state of a build (typically from the build queue). The BuildEnqueued event must be published before all other events for the same build ID. The backend will persist the event and deliver it to registered frontend jobs immediately without batching. The commit status of the request is reported by the RPC's util_status() function. The error code is the canonical error code defined in //util/task/codes.proto.
